ClockFixture.Meaning: Median of bracketed precise UTC/QPC offsets, accepted only within explicit observed clock bounds. Does not include GDI copy latency or prove physical A/V synchronization.

Meaning: Synthetic sample/timestamp placement, actual WAV bytes, rejection policies and exact UTC/QPC arithmetic. Not a live capture, measured A/V sync or performance test.

Checks.Name: Contiguous packets retain every sample with no padding
Clock gap explicitly reserves two frames instead of collapsing time
Actual WAV preserves both channels around explicit zero gap
Beginning and end trim address exact source frames
Outside capture coverage has explicit leading and trailing padding
One-sample clock jitter is reported without dropping samples
Larger overlapping timestamp fails instead of dropping samples
Clock conversion retains exact epoch arithmetic and brackets
Clock step beyond stated bound is rejected
